summary: Through August 27, 2026, Vercel serves GLM 5.2 - Z.ai's open-weights, long-horizon coding model with a 1M-token context window - at no cost for eve agents via Blackbox AI on AI Gateway. New eve agents get GLM 5.2 as their default model out of the box; existing agents switch with one line. The offer excludes Fast mode and the zai/glm-5.2-fast variant. After August 27, GLM 5.2 stays on AI Gateway at standard provider rates (about $0.80 per 1M input and $2.52 per 1M output). Note: a widely shared X post attributed this deal to Vercel's fx coding agent; Vercel's official changelog scopes it to eve agents (fx merely ships zai/glm-5.2 as its session default).
claim_steps: Initialize a new agent: npx eve@latest init my-agent - GLM 5.2 comes as the default model.
Existing agents: set model: "zai/glm-5.2" in agent/agent.ts, or run: eve set --model zai/glm-5.2.
Requests are served by Blackbox AI through Vercel AI Gateway at no cost through August 27, 2026.
Do not use Fast mode or the zai/glm-5.2-fast variant - both are excluded from the free offer.
After August 27, GLM 5.2 remains available on AI Gateway at standard provider rates.
